race.description: Wellington Soldiers Memorial Club Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: MOON DART (6) did lead them up when resuming and only went under by a head. He did mix his form when last in training. Gets a series of gear changes for good measure. Just needs some more luck off the wide gate too. ABOVE BOARD (7) can then get a softer run in transit and be a danger. Was forced to come from near last and made good ground resuming. Looks a contender. COMRADESHIP (2) was not beaten that far at his first effort for the new team. Won't be doing any sort of work early in the race either for this. BLIGHTY BOY (8) found the Scone race too tough after having an issue the run before. The tongue tie is off here.
